name: Linnx
description:
Your LinkedIn lives in one place, and your AI client can finally work with it.

Linnx pulls your conversations, connections, requests and posts into a single workspace. This connector opens that workspace to Claude.

Find the chat you half remember from three months ago. Ask who you have not replied to since spring. Pull the full text of every post you wrote about hiring and see which ones landed. File a year of conversations into categories you invented yourself. Draft the reply you have been putting off.

It reads your messages, connections, requests, posts and analytics, and it organises them: your own categories, groups, favourites, archives and drafts.

Linnx runs no AI of its own. No scoring, no classification, no summaries generated behind your back. Your assistant does the thinking, in your client, with your data. Linnx is the layer underneath that keeps it structured.

And it never sends. Linnx cannot message anyone for you, or accept a connection request on your behalf. Drafts wait in your inbox until you press send.

Needs a Linnx account with LinkedIn connected.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Linnx to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Linnx to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.linnx.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Linnx MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Linnx lists 30 MCP tools, including add_to_group, connection_analytics, create_category, create_group, dashboard_stats, delete_category, delete_group, follower_growth, get_chat, get_post, inbox_counts, and list_categories.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Linnx?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Linnx in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Linnx requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Linnx is developed by Linnx. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
